{{nihongo|'''Asukada Shrine'''|飛鳥田神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

It is Asukada Shrine listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}} of Kagami District, Mino Province. Under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine rank}}, it was a gōsha (village shrine).

=== Overview ===
It is traditionally said to have been founded in {{ill|Taika (era)|Q1077930|qid=Q1077930}} 5 ({{ill|649|ab|649|af|649|am|649 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|649|ar|649|ary|649|ast|649|avk|649|az|649|azb|۶۴۹ (میلادی)|be|649|be_x_old|649|bg|649|bn|৬৪৯|bpy|মারি ৬৪৯|br|649|bs|649.|ca|649|cdo|649 nièng|ceb|649|ckb|٦٤٩|crh|649|cs|649|cv|649|cy|649|da|649|de|649|el|649|eml|649|eo|649|es|649|et|649|eu|649|fa|۶۴۹ (میلادی)|fi|649|fo|649|fr|649|fy|649|ga|649|gan|649年|gd|649|gl|649|he|649|hi|649|hr|649.|ht|649 (almanak jilyen)|hu|649|hy|649|id|649|io|649|is|649|it|649|ja|649年|jv|649|ka|649|kk|649 жыл|ko|649년|la|649|lb|649|lij|649|lmo|649|lt|649 m.|map_bms|649|mdf|649|mg|649|mhr|649|mk|649|mr|इ.स. ६४९|mrj|649 и|ms|649|mzn|۶۴۹|nah|649|nap|649|nds|649|nds_nl|649|new|सन् ६४९|nl|649|nn|649|no|649|nrm|649|nso|649|oc|649|or|୬୪୯|os|649-æм аз|pl|649|pnb|649|pt|649|qu|649|ro|649|ru|649 год|rue|649|sa|६४९|scn|649|sd|649ع|se|649|sh|649.|shn|649|si|649|sk|649|sl|649|sq|649|sr|649|su|649|sv|649|sw|649|tg|Соли 649|th|พ.ศ. 1192|tk|649|tl|649|tly|649|tr|649|tt|649 ел|uk|649|ur|649ء|uz|649|vec|649|vi|649|war|649|wuu|649年|xmf|649|zh|649年|zh_min_nan|649 nî|zh_yue|649年|qid=Q31117}}). According to one theory, the {{ill|Soga clan|Q909854|qid=Q909854}}, including figures such as {{ill|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|es|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|fa|ساگا نو کورا یامادا نو ایشیکاوا نو مارو|fr|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|ja|蘇我倉山田石川麻呂|pt|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|ru|Сога-но Кура-но Ямада-но Исикава-но Маро|th|โซงะ โนะ คูรายามาดะ โนะ อิชิกาวะ โนะ มาโระ|vi|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|qid=Q3488899}}, once governed this area, and it is said that the place name “Sohara” derives from their possession of the land. It is presumed that the Soga clan transferred a deity from {{ill|Yamato Province|Q907495|qid=Q907495}} {{ill|Asuka|fa|آسوکا|ja|飛鳥|zh|飛鳥 (地名)|qid=Q11665953}} to this site.

In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}, it is listed as Shōsanmi Asukada Shrine, and during the {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}} it was called Asuka Daimyōjin.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Asukada Ōkami
: The nature of the deity is unknown. There is also a theory that the enshrined deity is {{ill|Prince Inishikiirihiko|ja|五十瓊敷入彦命|qid=Q11372194|lt=Ōnakatsuhiko no Mikoto}}.

=== Location ===
* 1-chome 105-1, Sohara Kiyozumi Town, Kakamigahara City, Gifu Prefecture

=== Transportation ===
* From the “Kiyozumi Town 1-chome” bus stop on the Kurachi Line of {{ill|Gifu Bus|Q5560101|qid=Q5560101|lt=Gifu Noriai Bus}}, a 5-minute walk.
* From the “Kiyozumi Town 1-chome” bus stop on the Sohara Line of the {{ill|Kakamigahara City Fureai Bus|Q11412316|qid=Q11412316}}, a 5-minute walk.

=== Other ===
* Sohara, where Asukada Shrine is located, has deep connections with the Soga clan. One of the enshrined deities at {{ill|Kasami Shrine|Q11398477|qid=Q11398477}}, located about 1 km to the southeast, is {{ill|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|es|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|fa|ساگا نو کورا یامادا نو ایشیکاوا نو مارو|fr|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|ja|蘇我倉山田石川麻呂|pt|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|ru|Сога-но Кура-но Ямада-но Исикава-но Маро|th|โซงะ โนะ คูรายามาดะ โนะ อิชิกาวะ โนะ มาโระ|vi|Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawa no Maro|qid=Q3488899}}. In addition, the tomb of Soga no Ishikawamaro ({{ill|Alleged Tomb of Soga no Kurayamada no Ishikawamaro|Q11381424|qid=Q11381424}}) and the ruins of Yamada-dera ({{ill|Yamada-dera Pagoda Foundation Stone|Q11470319|qid=Q11470319}}) are also nearby.
